name: phantom-image-trail
title: Phantom Image Trail
description: Cursor-driven image trail that spawns and fades stacked visuals as you move

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion support, restyled the reduced-motion notice, and removed per-frame setState calls from the mouse tracker to cut wasted re-renders.

props.name: imageMultiplier
props.description: Sets how many copies of the image set can be in flight.

props.name: triggerDistance
props.description: Distance the cursor must move before spawning a new image.

props.name: idleSpawn
props.description: Spawns images while the cursor rests.
